column1: # This sheet deliberately reuses re/types.id as its key, so that a divergent type
# can be joined straight onto its type and triage rows. That is the declared
# key_alias exception to preflight check 13, not an accidental collision.
# The client and server assemblies share 2952 types and differ by 12. This sheet
# is that difference, because it is the part of the two binaries that actually
# constrains the port: a shared type can be ported once, a divergent one cannot.
# Derived by comparing the ILSpy entity inventories of both assemblies, not by
# guessing from names. The `reason` column is interpretation and is marked as
# such by ref_conf on the rows where it is inference.
# The shape of the delta is what you would expect and it is worth stating: the
# server gains UPnP port mapping (a host must open its port) and the client gains
# everything presentational (Chroma RGB, MP3/OGG playback, compiled-shader
